question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the capitalised word in the given sentence.

The lunch menu includes some TEMPTING vegetarian offerings.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Repelling"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the meaning of the given synonym:

__
 
• **Tempting -** having an appeal 

 
 
• ​***Eg***. He made a *tempting* offer to me.
 
 
 
• ​**Repelling***** -*** to drive back 
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** They sought to *repel *the enemy with their machine guns.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here we will find the meaning of the other given words:

 
• **Seductive -** tending to seduce 

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He tries to *seduce *me every night.
 
 
 
• **Enticing -** arousing strong attraction or interest ​
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***Some of the most* enticing* food on the menu is in the "little bite" section, more than a dozen appetizers priced from $5 to $11 per plate.
 
 
 
• **​Tantalizing -** possessing a quality that arouses or stimulates desire or interest also
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Their job is to make safe and *tantalizing* gadgets and beds and toys that will stimulate an animal’s natural behaviors through sight, sound and texture.
